entries.title: Disney and AWS partner to develop AI-powered audio-animatronics of three Star Wars characters, debuting later in November at Amazon re:Invent in Las Vegas (Alex Weprin/The Hollywood Reporter)
Sources: ByteDance is in advanced talks with Microsoft to spend an additional ~$500M on Azure, primarily to access OpenAI models, drawing complaints from OpenAI (The Information)
Sources: Netflix will join Apple TV, YouTube, Fox, ESPN, and others in a bid for the US rights of FIFA's 2030 World Cup; the auction is set to fetch $1.5B-$2B (Matt Hughes/The Guardian)
A US court sentences Tyler Robert Buchanan, a 24-year-old British leader of Scattered Spider, to six years in prison for phishing and stealing $11.6M in crypto (Sergiu Gatlan/BleepingComputer)
Swiss nonprofit Quad9 withdraws its DNS resolver from France after a court ruling imposed large fines, an understandable decision that harms the open internet (Cloudflare)
Bengaluru-based Humyn Labs, which creates robot training data using first-person footage from cameras, raised $26M in equity led by Accel and $21M in debt (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
A look at AI-related literary disputes and debates over Pangram, which flagged Peruvian author David Silva Rojas's award-winning novel as 99% AI-generated (Brunella Tipismana Urbano/The Point ...)
Masayoshi Son says passing on investing in Anthropic in 2023 was a "mistake", noting that "by that point, we had already decided to invest in OpenAI" (Financial Times)
A growing religious and quasi-religious revival is permeating the AI industry, featuring apocalyptic warnings, secret prophecy lectures, and fringe movements (Sam Kriss/New Yorker)
Rockstar says GTA VI targets 30fps across all current-gen consoles; PS5 and Xbox Series X upscale the game from 1440p to 4K and Xbox Series S from 720p to 1080p (Alessio Palumbo/Wccftech)
An interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson on the "risk" of a romantic story, switching from GTA V's split storyline to co-dependent partnership, and more (Andrew Webster/The Verge)
GTA VI's main campaign completion time ranged from 42 hours for a "rushed" playthrough to 115 hours for an exploration-heavy playthrough across four reviewers (IGN)
Sony and Rockstar say a new PS5 firmware update is mandatory to play GTA VI ahead of its November 19 launch; the update aims to combat rapid homebrew exploits (Wesley Yin-Poole/IGN)
GTA VI review: an unparalleled technical and comedic masterpiece, with elaborate depictions of a heightened reality and an unpredictable environment by design (Jason Schreier/Bloomberg)
KPMG uses 100+ AI agents to conduct a parallel audit of a FTSE 250 company in a pilot, saying the AI asked "better questions" and dug deeper than human staff (Financial Times)
